name.en-US: Lives of the Holy Abbots of Wearmouth and Jarrow
name.pt-BR: Vida dos Santos Abades de Wearmouth e Jarrow

description.la: Historia abbatum, id est Vita sanctorum abbatum monasterii in Wiramutha et Girvum: Benedicti Biscop, Ceolfridi, Eosterwini, Sigfridi et Hwaetberhti (post 716).
description.en-US: Bede's history of the first abbots of his own monastery, written after 716: Benedict Biscop, who founded Wearmouth and Jarrow and brought books and builders from Rome; Ceolfrith, who carried the Codex Amiatinus on his last journey; and Eosterwine, Sigfrith and Hwaetberht. Latin text of Migne (PL 94); English translation of J. A. Giles as given by the Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
description.pt-BR: A história dos primeiros abades do próprio mosteiro de Beda, escrita depois de 716: Bento Biscop, que fundou Wearmouth e Jarrow e trouxe de Roma livros e artífices; Ceolfrido, que levou o Codex Amiatinus na última viagem; e Eosterwine, Sigfrido e Hwaetberht.

sources.edition: Vita V sanctorum abbatum (Beda) on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne PL 94 (Liber I and Liber II).
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one chapter with the two books marked.
